## Summary

Describe what changed and why. Include supporting links where possible.

If you are the project's author or a maintainer, say so here.

## Checklist

For entry additions or updates; remove items that do not apply.

- [ ] New entries meet the [listing criteria](../CONTRIBUTING.md#what-belongs-here).
- [ ] Added or updated rows follow the [directory format](../CONTRIBUTING.md#adding-an-entry) and case-insensitive alphabetical order.
